objects.title: Small gaps between primes

source_roles.johnston_yang: inherited provenance only; not invoked for linear-r prime-tail asymptotics
source_roles.maynard: bounded consecutive gaps plus finite-pigeonhole extraction of one repeated h_*

theorem.coarse_pair_lower: under r<=C*x, every natural pair max has liminf at least exp(-1200*C)/2
theorem.fixed_gap_extraction: there exist one fixed positive integer h_*<=600 and infinitely many consecutive-prime edges x=p_y,q=p_(y+1)=x+h_*
theorem.lambda_pair_lower: if r/x->lambda, a0=exp(-2*lambda*h_*), and every natural pair max has liminf at least a0/(1+a0)
theorem.linear_rank_regime: for each fixed C>0, exact same-edge ranks r=r_y satisfy r->infinity and r<=C*x
theorem.necessity_scope: same rank at both endpoints; pairwise P/J/I hierarchy only
theorem.next_rank_divergence: the scalar pair errors and gamma-normalized endpoint pair errors, divided by P_(r+1), tend to infinity
theorem.optional_profile_regime: the lambda profile additionally assumes r/x->lambda in [0,infinity)
theorem.sublinear_pair_lower: if r=o(x) and r->infinity, every natural pair max has liminf at least 1/2
